Traced the failing file to its origin — placed in shared folder by a different project
Discovered multiple projects share the same Distrib path
Identified CAS read-only hard links making files unsignable
Proposed removing Distrib/Robocopy from library projects so only the service project owns the folder
Verified the fix ensures each project signs only its own files

scenarios.scenario: Deep — Full autonomous root cause investigation and fix proposal
scenarios.reasoning: Efficient, methodical investigation (31 calls, no real dead-ends aside from one wasted find) producing a well-evidenced, well-structured report that nails the error, file, shared-Distrib root cause, and non-determinism, plus useful secondary findings. The read-only mechanism is somewhat muddled (locks vs CoW vs hardlinks) and the fix, while sound, differs from the canonical remedy and isn't verified beyond reasoning.
